title: The Stasis Vessel
description: A magical wooden shop stall at dusk displays a giant glass bottle filled with blue liquid, a sailing ship, white butterflies, and a small dragon. A robed figure stands at the open door writing on parchment while a black raven perches on the counter beside an open book and scattered papers.
prompt: A whimsical fantasy shop stall on a cobblestone street at twilight, featuring a massive glass stasis vessel containing a sailing ship, white butterflies, and a tiny dragon suspended in deep blue liquid, a robed wizard writing on parchment at the doorway, a black raven perched on the wooden counter with open books and scrolls, hanging lanterns casting warm light, blue magical symbols floating in the air, ornate wooden sign reading 'THE STASIS VESSEL - SPELLS IN AMBER & INK'
